reason: Although the PR is framed as telemetry removal, the metadata shows substantive changes in core SQL-layer paths: parser grammar/keywords/AST (`pkg/parser/*`), planner/executor handling for telemetry statements (`pkg/planner/core/*`, `pkg/executor/*`), and session/sysvar/context/kv surfaces (`pkg/session/*`, `pkg/sessionctx/*`, `pkg/kv/option.go`).
